doc: With no editor connected, the hub reads <config>/settings.el itself (data only, through huginn): a profile of the user's joins the 7 built-in ones, a provider of the user's joins the 16 presets, and status.settings says so. A comment, a :mode section and a package's entry change nothing.

text:
;;; settings.el --- your settings  -*- mode: lisp-data -*-
(drgnx-settings
 :version 1
 ;; my review agent
 (drgnx-agents-profiles (("review" :command ("claude-agent-acp") :mode queue :model "opus" :doc "Reviews")))
 (drgnx-ai-providers ((work :kind openai :url "https://llm.example/v1" :key-env "WORK_KEY" :caps (chat))))
 (fill-column 100)
 (:mode python-ts-mode (fill-column 88)))
